race.comment: EIGHTYSEVEN LAD (1) is third-up now and the two efforts to begin this campaign were superb. He'll find this a little easier third-up and Faithfull sticking is a big push for his chances. Can go one better this time around. PEANUT BUTTER (2) is building nicely, missing by 2.8L at this trip at Northam most recently. Fiore hops on board now and this race looks to shape nicely for him. Recent ratings stack up and he looks to get his chance today. BLAMEITONTHERAIN (12) is on debut today, having switched from the Luciani barn to the Fernie stable. He's shown enough at the trials to suggest he's not to be discounted on debut. Drawn nicely and can play a leading role. OUR ENCHANTRESS (9) can improve now third-up into the campaign. SHIMARI (6) can improve now third-up.
